title: Vulos desktop layout pack, version 1
description: A layout pack describes where the dock lives, what it holds on a desktop and on a phone, which side the window controls sit on, and up to five allowlisted appearance tokens. It cannot contain CSS, URLs, scripts or selectors — see roadmap/CUSTOMIZATION.md. This schema documents the format; src/desktop/validate.ts is the enforcing implementation and is stricter (it also range-checks token values and rejects unknown keys).

id.description: Lowercase slug. Must not collide with a built-in preset id.

name.description: Named for what the layout does, not for whose desktop it resembles.

familiar.description: Which platform's habits this matches, in plain words. Ergonomics, not imitation.

summary.description: One preview-safe sentence. Rendered verbatim in the first-boot picker.

dock.description: One profile per form factor. A phone dock is not a narrow desktop dock: it may hold different items and is held to stricter limits.

style.description: floating = rounded island inset from the edge; bar = full-span strip flush with it.

launcher.description: Show the search/launcher affordance in the strip.

assistant.description: Show the assistant panel toggle in the strip.

drawer.description: Show a persistent app-drawer affordance. Required on mobile.

items.description: Ordered app ids the dock offers by default. Seeds the user's pins; never overwrites them.

edge.description: A phone dock may only sit on a horizontal edge — a vertical strip costs 17% of a 390px screen on the axis it has least of.

size.description: A phone dock may not use the 36px small tile — every target is hit with a thumb.

items.description: Five items plus the drawer gives ~62px slots at 390px, clearing the 44px touch target.

tokens.description: The complete allowlist. Values are also RANGE-checked by the implementation; the floors exist so no pack can make a control invisible or untappable.

--vd-dock-radius.description: 0px – 28px. Corner radius of the dock strip.

--vd-dock-opacity.description: 0.6 – 1. Dock surface opacity; floors at 0.6 so the dock can never be made invisible.

--vd-window-radius.description: 0px – 24px. Corner radius of a window frame.

--vd-accent.description: Accent colour. Legibility-corrected against the active theme before it is drawn as text.
